transformation: Outcome-blind full-source projection of active, unambiguous single-house address groups with an explicit mode: ADD_AND_FILL or POSTCODE_FILL_ONLY. Both use deterministic duplicate collapse and base postcode precedence. POSTCODE_FILL_ONLY admits only exact existing base identities, preserves every base coordinate and row, and uses facility coordinates only for conservative source validation; it never writes them as address points.
warning: The official register is not guaranteed complete; facility coordinates can denote a charging location rather than a building centroid.
